Container.Name: LNbits
Container.Overview: LNbits is a free and open-source Bitcoin Lightning wallet and accounts system. It provides isolated wallets, API keys, LNURL tools, extensions, merchant workflows, and admin controls on top of a configurable Lightning funding source.
Container.Requires: LNbits stores its SQLite database, logs, super user state, and installed extensions in the Data path. Back this directory up before using real funds. The default backend is VoidWallet so the UI can start without a Lightning node; set Backend Wallet Class and the matching advanced variables before accepting real payments. The Admin UI stores most settings in the database after first install, so use the Admin UI or reset stored settings if later environment changes do not appear.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: LNbits web interface and API port. Container port: 5000.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent LNbits data, SQLite database, logs, super user state, backups, and installed extensions.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Optional .env file based on the upstream .env.example. Leave blank to configure with the variables in this template and the Admin UI.

Config.Name: Data Folder
Config.Description: LNbits data folder inside the container. Keep this pointed at the Data mount.

Config.Name: Extensions Path
Config.Description: Persistent path for installed LNbits extensions. Without this, installed extensions can be lost when the container is recreated.

Config.Name: Admin UI
Config.Description: Enable the LNbits Admin UI and first-install super user flow. Use true or false.

Config.Name: HTTPS Only Auth Cookies
Config.Description: Set true when LNbits is served only over HTTPS. Leave false for direct local HTTP access through the Unraid Web UI.

Config.Name: Backend Wallet Class
Config.Description: Lightning funding source class. Start with VoidWallet for testing, then use PhoenixdWallet, LndRestWallet, LndWallet, CoreLightningWallet, or another supported backend.

Config.Name: Default Extensions
Config.Description: Comma-separated extensions installed by default on restart. Remove an extension from this list before uninstalling it permanently.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Optional public URL used behind a reverse proxy, for example https://lnbits.example.com/.

Config.Name: Site Title
Config.Description: Browser and UI title for this LNbits instance.

Config.Name: Auth Secret Key
Config.Description: Recommended strong random secret for auth signing. Set this before production use.

Config.Name: First Install Token
Config.Description: Optional token required on the first-install page.

Config.Name: Allowed Auth Methods
Config.Description: Comma-separated auth methods, for example user-id-only, username-password, nostr-auth-nip98, google-auth, github-auth, keycloak-auth, or oidc-auth.

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Enable verbose debug mode. Use True or False.

Config.Name: Forwarded Allow IPs
Config.Description: Trusted proxy IPs for forwarded headers. Use * when LNbits is behind a trusted local reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Postgres Database URL
Config.Description: Optional external database URL. Leave blank to use SQLite in the Data path.

Config.Name: Phoenixd API Endpoint
Config.Description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is PhoenixdWallet. Use the reachable Phoenixd HTTP API URL, for example http://UNRAID-IP:9740/ or http://phoenixd:9740/ on a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: Phoenixd API Password
Config.Description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is PhoenixdWallet. Use the Phoenixd full-access API password from phoenix.conf.

Config.Name: LND Data
Config.Description: Optional read-only mount for an LND data directory. Useful when using LndWallet or LndRestWallet with cert and macaroon paths under /lnd.

Config.Name: LND REST Endpoint
Config.Description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndRestWallet. Use the reachable LND REST URL, for example https://UNRAID-IP:8081/ or https://lnd:8080/ on a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: LND REST Cert
Config.Description: LND TLS certificate path inside the LNbits container, or the certificate content accepted by LNbits.

Config.Name: LND REST Macaroon
Config.Description: LND admin macaroon path inside the LNbits container, or hex/base64 macaroon content.

Config.Name: LND gRPC Endpoint
Config.Description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndWallet. Hostname or IP of the LND gRPC endpoint.

Config.Name: LND gRPC Port
Config.Description: Required when Backend Wallet Class is LndWallet. LND gRPC port.

Config.Name: LND gRPC Cert
Config.Description: LND TLS certificate path inside the LNbits container, or the certificate content accepted by LNbits.

Config.Name: LND gRPC Macaroon
Config.Description: LND admin macaroon path inside the LNbits container, or hex/base64 macaroon content.
